ops.body: Fixed in 0.9.0 (commit 413d5f2438d8, tag v0.9.0, PyPI live). (1) Campaign.reconcile() closes every crash-orphaned reservation with a terminal RECONCILED ledger row at max(reserved, durable actual) — the $3-reserved/$4-actual/$5-cap repro is a red-first test in tests/test_research_meta.py; idempotent; a torn journal raises PoisonedJournal and refuses startup. (2) procs.abort_latches() + run_campaign raising AccountingIntegrityError inside the campaign lock BEFORE the orphan scan — the latch-survives/seq2-completed repro red-first in test_research_meta.py. (3) started/deadline moved above driver.preflight(), which now runs inside anyio.move_on_after(max_wall_s) sharing the wall-exhaustion exit — red-first in test_research_loop.py; cancel-safety audited; seven sibling wall-timing tests widened deliberately (WALL_CANCEL_BUDGET_S=0.6, subprocess tests 2.0) because preflight now consumes wall time.
